diagnosis: Customer reports a one-hour window of missed webhooks yesterday. KB-0015 confirms failed deliveries are available for manual replay for seven days, so the events should still be recoverable. The account is on business plan with standard support, so no premium SLA applies, but the replay feature is available to them.
reply: I understand your concern about the missed webhooks yesterday. According to our webhook delivery system, events that fail delivery are automatically retried for about an hour and then remain available for manual replay for up to seven days. I recommend using the manual replay function in your dashboard to resend those events. If you need guidance on locating the replay option, our knowledge base article on webhook delivery and replay has detailed steps.
